required_pr_review.summary: Exact-head Pullfrog review evidence is the primary required PR-review source.
required_pr_review.fallback_summary: Neither self-managed nor Mergeguez review evidence satisfies normal closeout; both exact-head Pullfrog checks are mandatory.

local_validation.summary: Workflow custody, reviewer-cutover policy tests, secret-mapping regression coverage, YAML and JSON parsing, Speculoos validation, publish-check, and git diff checks passed for the Pullfrog reviewer cutover.

github_checks.summary: The cutover PR checks must be read live at the current exact head before merge; no self-referential head SHA is committed.

self_managed.summary: Emergency fallback only; not the normal review lane.

pullfrog_review.summary: Required exact-head evidence consists of a completed successful pullfrog run check and successful pullfrog-approval verdict check attached to the current PR head, plus the corresponding Pullfrog review output. Any remediation push makes all earlier review and check evidence stale and requires a fresh exact-head re-review.
pullfrog_review.evidence_ref: live PR checks and Pullfrog review thread

mergeguez_review.summary: Mergeguez review evidence is retained only as historical provenance and is not accepted for normal closeout after the Pullfrog cutover.
